scenarios.scenario-1: Atomic writes preserve content/mode and backups are discoverable/removable.
scenarios.scenario-2: Unwritable targets produce typed CONFIG_WRITE_FAILED; backup collisions never overwrite.
scenarios.scenario-3: The installer re-exports the extracted helpers without API changes.

required-log-markers.marker-1: No runtime markers; tests assert content, mode, backup names and typed errors.
